exec: const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('HTTP200与业务200',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).eq(200);pm.expect(b.code).eq(200);});let done=0;const results=[];const send=(method,url,body,index)=>setTimeout(()=>{const started=Date.now();pm.sendRequest({url:pm.environment.get('rsHost')+url,method,header:{Authorization:'Bearer '+pm.collectionVariables.get('rsToken1'),'Content-Type':'application/json'},...(body?{body:{mode:'raw',raw:JSON.stringify(body)}}:{})},(err,res)=>{pm.test('并发请求可达',()=>pm.expect(err).eq(null));if(!err)results.push({code:res.json().code,started,ended:Date.now()});if(++done===2){pm.test('一次成功一次拒绝',()=>pm.expect(results.map(x=>x.code).sort()).deep.eq([200,500]));pm.test('请求实际重叠',()=>pm.expect(Math.max(...results.map(x=>x.started))).below(Math.min(...results.map(x=>x.ended))));console.log('RS_RACE='+JSON.stringify(results));}});},index*100);send('POST','/resume/902/experience',{"companyName":"回归企业","position":"后端开发","experienceType":"FORMAL","startDate":"2026-01-01","endDate":"2026-06-30","isCurrent":false,"description":"完成接口开发"},0);send('PUT','/resume/902/basic',{title:'并发简历',formalExperienceStatus:'NONE'},1);
